high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "theidolfacts." The post features a photograph that combines elements of a 500 Indian Rupee (INR) note with a real-life scene of the Red Fort in Delhi, India. Main Image: The top portion of the image shows a 500 INR note, which prominently displays the Red Fort as part of its design. The bottom portion of the image shows the actual Red Fort in Delhi, with a crowd of people gathered in front of it, likely tourists visiting the landmark.
